title: Chip Repair Guarantee Credit Redemption Terms (Workmanship Warranties)
content:
**Term.** A Chip Repair Guarantee under the Workmanship Warranties is redeemed once: on the completion date of the network windshield replacement that used its chip credit, the coverage moves to redeemed and cannot be used again. A guarantee whose concern was not covered, or whose windshield was replaced outside the network, is not redeemed.

The chip credit exists only where the plan credits the amount paid for the chip repair toward a windshield replacement by the network when the chip spreads.

## Redemption outcomes

| Circumstance | Outcome for the guarantee |
|---|---|
| The network completes a windshield replacement that used the guarantee's chip credit | Redeemed on that completion date; cannot be used again |
| The concern was not covered | Not redeemed |
| The windshield was replaced outside the network | Not redeemed |

## Points of the term

- **Date of redemption.** The coverage moves to redeemed on the completion date of the network windshield replacement, which is also the date recorded for the credit's use.
- **Once only.** After redemption the guarantee cannot be used again.

Q. A Chip Repair Guarantee holder had the windshield replaced at an independent glass shop (hypothetical case). Is the guarantee redeemed?
A. No. A guarantee whose windshield was replaced outside the network is not redeemed.

Q. The network has completed a windshield replacement that used the guarantee's chip credit. Can the same guarantee credit a second replacement later?
A. No. It is redeemed once and cannot be used again.
